messages.en: The cost of living has gone up. I'm just going to bring my own lunch this week.
Same here. Eating at home is cheaper anyway.
I came across the word sarah in the dictionary earlier. Does it mean serah?
Yeah, that's a dialect form. If you're writing a formal letter, just use the standard form.
Have you had breakfast yet? I'm thinking of going to that shop up ahead.
Not yet. Give me a sec and we'll go together.
Has the sergeant arrived at the office yet?
Yes, he's waiting out front. I'll hand over this file first.
